name: Natsuiro no Sora no Shita de
source:
Main character's parents go abroad, so he stays at his cousin Reika's house. He spends days happily at school with friends. But once a mysterious transfer student enters the classroom, and things start to change rapidly.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父母出國後，他便寄住在親戚Reika家中，每天在學校裡與朋友們快樂相處。然而某天，一位神秘的轉學生走進教室，一切開始急劇變化。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
